title: Start before you need the money

landing-it.title: Landing it
landing-it.keywords: one board left, one question, when do you start, decided by what you start now
landing-it.script: We are almost there. One board is left, and it asks one question. When do you start? Everything so far was one idea, told on one board: the money you need later is decided by what you start now.
